10 استمدّ مِنَ الدَّوَاةِ ; (A, L, Msb, K:) and ↓ مَدَّ مِنْهَا , inf. n. مَدٌّ; (L, Msb, K;) He took ink from the receptacle thereof with the reed-pen, for writing: (Msb:) or he took a dip from the receptacle of ink with the reed-pen. (L.) See also 1. ―
-b2- استمدّ النَّفَسَ [He drew breath.] (M,
TA, art. نفس.) ―
-b3- استمدّ He asked, sought, or desired مدَدَ [or aid, or succour, in war, &c.]. (S, L, K.) ―
-b4- استمدّهُ He asked, sought, or desired, of him (a commander, A) مَدد [or aid, or succour, in war, &c.] (A, * L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
